name: Represents EC2 Instance
description: An SSM managed instance is SSM's record of an EC2 instance (managed instance -> instance): DescribeInstanceInformation's InstanceId when its ResourceType is EC2Instance. A hybrid (mi-) node has none. A reference, not containment. Collected by the SSM walk (collectors/boto3_collector/ssm_patch.py, aws-core-tap#281, req-aws-core-ssm-patch-state).
